nodes.dialogue_text: Acharya, the boy is a tempest! As long as he holds a bow, even the gods cannot touch him. We must strike from behind and break his weapons.
It is adharma... but there is no other way. Karna, cut his bowstring from behind. The rest of you, converge!
Cowards! Six maharathis against one unarmed boy! Come then! Even with just this chariot wheel, I am the son of Arjuna, and I yield to no one!
